import math

x, y, nn = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())

ans = 1000000.0
n = x

            n = h
            d = i
            ans = hh
    else:
        if ll < ans - eps:
            n = l
            d = i
            ans = ll

print(f"{n}/{d}")
